description: Machine availability must be valid at the operation's effective execution interval.
Only eligible process/resource combinations may be selected for the exact product revision and operation.
Processing duration must bind the exact operation, process recipe, units and model revision.
Capability must be qualified under the applicable process/material/environment envelope rather than inferred from a declared machine label.
Product claims and process eligibility must bind the exact product/engineering revision.
Resource exclusive capacity and overlapping reservations must be respected.
Required worker skill/qualification must be current and applicable to the task.
Worker shift, assignment and rest/availability constraints must be respected.
Exact tool/fixture identity and compatible configuration must be bound to the operation.
Tool/fixture contention and use intervals must be represented.
AGV or transport resource capacity and availability must be represented.
Transport and arrival must precede use at the destination operation.
Maintenance windows and lockout/unavailability intervals must constrain resource use.
Sequence-dependent setup, cleaning or changeover transitions must be represented.
Required segregation/cleaning constraints must prevent prohibited process/material transitions.
Operation input must bind to the correct material lot and genealogy.
Material certificate and property evidence must apply to the exact lot, revision and process envelope.
First-article acceptance must occur before downstream release steps that depend on it.
Required inspection must be performed and supported by applicable independent evidence; duplicate reports from one origin are not independent.
Instrument calibration must be current at measurement time.
Measurement method and instrument range must cover the exact measurand and decision boundary.
Material state and parameters must remain inside the qualified process envelope with units/uncertainty preserved.
Every relied-on source must be identified without conflating different assets, products, lots or reports.
Every relied-on source revision must be known and current for the decision.
Effective time and observed/recorded time must remain distinct and ordered by the declared event semantics.
Only evidence observable by the decision epoch may influence model changes.
Identical observable prefixes must yield identical pre-event model/action decisions.
Planning or model generation must not imply permission to prepare, execute or release a physical action.
Required electrical, thermal, pressure, atmosphere or other process utilities must meet the declared envelope.
